name: rosetta-isbn13-check-digit
code:
use default

digit_value(digit: char) -> int => cast int(digit) - cast int('0')

checksum(code: string) -> int =>
    code
        |> filter(character => char.is_digit(character))
        |> index()
        |> reduce(0, (total, digit) =>
            total + digit_value(digit.value) *
                (if digit.index % 2 == 0 then 1 else 3 fi))

for code in ["978-0596528126", "978-0596528120",
             "978-1788399081", "978-1788399083"] do
    let verdict = if checksum(code) % 10 == 0 then "good" else "bad" fi

    write_line("{code}: {verdict}")
od
